model_source.extra_structure: actual directed FEM mesh edges supplied by caller

normalization_groups.definition: sqrt(trace(training displacement covariance)/3), shared by all three vector components

contract.label_source: Frozen public phone OpenRadioss20us canonical fields; original RAD reference geometry and nominal-frame interpolation

quality_gates.failure_action: Report insufficient budget; do not silently extend cap

budget_tracker_validation_count_definiti: Interval-reset marks at the currently completed training epoch; excludes initial and a restored final state after partial work. All actual validation events are counted separately.
convergence: Unverified. A bounded initial comparison, not an optimized recipe; inspect the recorded validation curve and improvement at the last eligible state.
optimizer: Adam constant learning_rate0.001; mean normalized squared error over B,N,time,channel
training_unit: One case observation contains all nodes and stored10times. Native batches average the complete case losses; the last smaller batch and actual observations are explicitly counted.
timing_boundary: CUDA synchronized wall time around zero_grad, forward, loss, finite-loss/gradient checks, backward, Adam step. Inputs and labels are prepared/copied before the timer. File preparation, validation, CPU snapshots/checkpoint I/O and monitoring are excluded from the compute cap.

workloads.note: Observed solver PID/time intervals and boundary RSS samples; not exact process exit times or continuous peaks. Shared workstation timings may include CPU/host-memory contention. No claim of isolated GPU system performance.

data_access_disclosure: No test response values used in training or checkpoint selection; READY/contract provenance verification hashes files from every split.

validation_roundtrip.definition: New model constructed from serialized checkpoint; same validation input only
